summary: The Community installer ships with every release, and the status at Invardia says more.

fixes.title: Installer in every release
fixes.text: The Community installer is part of every release download and always carries the version it installs, also for a security patch of the release.

fixes.title: Clearer status at Invardia
fixes.text: The status shows which version each run used, a stopped run as ended, and the update result right after the update. The setup no longer gives Invardia Support any of the engine's own roles.

fixes.title: Old sample copies after a Community update
fixes.text: Community installations that update keep old-named copies of three sample files beside the new ones. Nothing reads them, and they can be deleted.
